topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: This city’s always been full of secrets, each one older than the last. Got a call today from a woman, her voice all shaky. Found a room, she said, in the house she just moved into. Hidden, been there who knows how long. Heard the door creak, and there it was, like a ghost behind the wall. Asked her what was inside, but she couldn’t tell me much. Just said it was dark, and the air was colder than the rest of the place. Told her I'd be there soon. Old houses have their own ways of whispering to those who listen. Maybe this one had something to say. Or maybe it’s just another room. But then, how many rooms are just rooms?
